summary.text: Jerri Green is a member of the Memphis City Council representing District 2 and the Democratic nominee for governor. She is an attorney and former public defender and executive director of the Community Legal Center.

paragraphs.text: Green was born and raised in Memphis and graduated from White Station High School.
She earned a Bachelor of Arts in English and political science from the University of Tennessee, Knoxville, in 1999 and a Juris Doctor from Georgetown University Law Center in 2003.

Green began her legal career as a juvenile public defender in Nashville and later became executive director of the Community Legal Center in Memphis, which provides legal services to people who could not otherwise afford them.
She also served Shelby County Mayor Lee Harris as senior policy advisor and deputy chief of staff, and her campaign biography says she was appointed Shelby County's Chief Public Defender.
Green joined the Memphis City Council, representing District 2, on January 1, 2024.
She won the August 6, 2026 Democratic primary for governor and is the party's nominee in the November 3 general election.
